activation.note: Activation covers existing and new non-draft WMBTs without acceptance, independently of the current diff or phase, and excludes both authored exceptions. The artifact-classification and finding integrations are explicitly labeled needs_new_observer rather than claimed as available.

audit.summary: All sixteen segments survive at their claimed destinations, retaining the acceptance threshold, draft exception, allow-list, and provenance. Additional guidance and rationale are declared; the shared strict-disposition node is generic and contains its claimed policy meaning.

segmentChecks.note: The given/then/unless fields retain the at-least-one acceptance requirement and the draft exception without narrowing it to changed WMBTs.
The exact validator type and reference remain in audit, while evidence correctly describes the expected zero-finding result.
The normative coverage requirement and draft exception survive in then, unless, and the verifier algorithm.
The wmbts_without_acceptance allow-list is retained as an explicit exception in given, unless, activation, and verifier_detail.
Severity 3 is preserved verbatim in verifier_detail and audit.
Strict disposition remains explicit in verifier_detail and audit; the shared node only states the generic fail-on-every-finding policy meaning.
The non-draft WMBT acceptance invariant is restated faithfully in then, why, and verifier_detail.

risks: The coder-facing fields do not specify the repository's concrete syntax for linking an acceptance to a WMBT or the location/schema of the wmbts_without_acceptance allow-list, so an agent implementing edits must discover those artifact details separately.

review.summary: The rewrite preserves the coverage threshold, both exceptions, validator provenance, severity, and strict disposition; I agree with the auditor's PASS. The coder-facing decision is clear, although artifact linkage syntax must be learned from the repository and activation is not currently executable by Datalog because both declared facts require new observers.
